requirements.text: Select the first concept-root migration boundary using drift-lens evidence across candidate concepts.
Bind the selected first boundary to compatibility constraints covering package behavior, entrypoints, adapters, tests, direct Node execution, and package loading.
Create/refine implementation task boundaries only after the selected first target is approved, and do not move source files during TASK-014.
Explicitly defer heavier concept roots with owner, trigger, and rationale until agency pilot evidence exists.

evidence_mapping.criterion: Drift-lens evidence compares candidate first concepts.
evidence_mapping.evidence: Agency has the smallest complete vertical slice among candidates: 3 concept files, 9 incoming import edges, 5 outgoing import edges, and 3 smoke-test touchpoints; state/roadmap/session/project have broader import and test coupling; audit has /audit public-command risk; build/validation are gateway-critical.

.codewiki/kb/system/file-structure.md now records package behavior, package entrypoint, adapter schema/tool behavior, direct Node execution, package loading, typecheck, smoke/feature/package checks, and test-backed temporary compatibility shims as agency-pilot gates.

evidence_mapping.criterion: Implementation boundary waits for approval and excludes source moves in TASK-014.
evidence_mapping.evidence: No source files were moved in TASK-014; only KB/diagram/build/roadmap planning artifacts are produced. Planning may create one agency-pilot implementation task after this accepted decision.

evidence_mapping.criterion: Deferrals include owner, trigger, and rationale.
evidence_mapping.evidence: Maintainers own deferred heavy concepts; trigger is closed agency pilot with task-close validation and compatibility evidence; rationale is to learn import/barrel/package cost from the low-blast-radius pilot before moving audit/build/validation/session/roadmap/state/project.

summary: Select agency as first concept-root migration boundary

diff_table.current_state: The accepted concept-root target names agency as a target root, but agency code remains split across src/domain/agency/types.ts, src/application/agency.ts, and src/application/tools/agency.ts; adapters call these paths directly, and no durable first migration target is selected.
diff_table.desired_state: Select agency as the first concept-root migration boundary: src/agency/** should be the pilot concept root, containing agency model/types, planning use case, and tool/API entrypoint, while adapters/ui continue to call stable exported entrypoints during a staged migration.
diff_table.rationale: Drift-lens comparison favors agency as the smallest complete vertical slice among candidates: 3 concept files, 9 incoming import edges, 5 outgoing import edges, and 3 smoke-test touchpoints. It exercises the target model+use-case+tool shape without moving central graph/state/roadmap/build/validation/project infrastructure first.
diff_table.risk: medium migration risk; mitigated by pilot size and compatibility gates.

diff_table.current_state: The file-structure target already requires preserved public package behavior, compatibility exports, direct Node execution, package loading, and TypeScript checks, but TASK-014 has not yet bound those constraints to the first migration pilot.
diff_table.desired_state: Bind the agency pilot to explicit compatibility gates: no public package behavior change, no package entrypoint change, no adapter schema/tool behavior change, compatibility barrels/re-export shims as needed, direct Node execution preserved, package loading preserved, typecheck plus smoke/feature/package checks run, and no cleanup of old paths until tests and import updates prove parity.
diff_table.rationale: Recent compatibility guarantees and package smoke coverage must survive source moves.
diff_table.risk: medium shim-staleness risk; mitigate by time-boxing shims and requiring tests.
alternatives: Delay until broader API facade exists.

diff_table.current_state: No implementation task currently owns a concept-root source move after TASK-014; creating one before approval would violate TASK-014 acceptance.
diff_table.desired_state: After approval, create one implementation task for the agency pilot only. Boundary: move/introduce src/agency/**, update imports/barrels/adapters/tests for agency, preserve compatibility, run typecheck/smoke/feature/package checks, and do not migrate audit/build/validation/session/state/roadmap/project in the same task.
diff_table.rationale: A single pilot task is executable and independently validatable.
diff_table.risk: medium; pilot may not expose all issues but provides evidence for next ordering.

diff_table.current_state: State, roadmap, session, build, validation, audit, and project are all target concepts, but their current import/test coupling varies widely and no staged order is recorded.
diff_table.desired_state: Defer heavier concepts until after the agency pilot closes. Proposed second-wave decision trigger: agency migration validates compatibility gates and reveals import/barrel cleanup cost. Candidate next targets after pilot: audit if /audit compatibility risk is understood, then build/validation, then session/roadmap/state/project only after shared API/import patterns stabilize.
diff_table.rationale: Unmigrated roots remain approved migration deltas when owner, trigger, and rationale are recorded.
diff_table.risk: low-medium stall risk; mitigated by maintainer owner and pilot-close trigger.
